changelog: Channels now save immediately while schedule generation continues in the background. Collection sources selected through title search are treated as real content, and the library source picker has a search field for large libraries. The duplicate configuration-language control is removed.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
